target: forge.sh pr-create — no usable remote prints local, exits 0, makes no forge call (control: with a remote it does)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":3,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/3"}'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show noremote
export FORGE=gitlab; fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show declared; unset FORGE
echo "calls_before=$(fx_ncalls)"
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show control
fx_reqs
fx_done
